name: Tlog photo library
description: Chronological photo/video library with year/month views, favorites, native scrolling, animated viewer, thumbnail scrubber, zoom/pan, metadata, copy link and save/share.

files.host.css: Minimal source-theme typography and document reset.
files.tlog.html: Reusable adapted feature DOM, SVG and inline data.
files.tlog.css: Extracted feature styles with HTTPS font URLs.
files.tlog.js: Original native controller with static-host Copy Link adaptation.
files.tlog.original.html: Exact feature HTML extracted from user source.
files.source-analysis.json: Attachment equality, source hashes, DOM/data inventory.
files.controller-reference.json: Source function offsets, behavior and integration contracts.
files.asset-manifest.json: 1394 checked media/font URLs and fetched source dependencies.
files.validation.json: Automated and browser validation, publication status.
